info.title: Analog Terrax API
info.description: Scalable FastAPI backend infrastructure for Analog Terrax.

get.description: Return service health metadata for monitoring and frontend status checks.

get.summary: List real extracted NASA Earthdata ATLAS/ICESat-2 L2A (ATL03 v007) records for all Earth sites
get.description: Return full extracted NASA Earthdata ATL03 v007 records (granules, orbit info, geolocation segments, and photons) for all curated Earth sites.

schema.title: Response Planetary List Earthdata Atl03 Records

get.summary: Get real extracted NASA Earthdata ATLAS/ICESat-2 L2A (ATL03 v007) record for a specific Earth site
get.description: Retrieve the extracted NASA Earthdata ATL03 v007 granule, segments, and photon samples for an Earth site_id or cell_id.

get.summary: Get harmonized cross-planet taxonomy and feature normalization stats
get.description: Return shared lithology classes, similarity matrix, mineral dimensions, and topo stats.

get.summary: List curated reference sites for Moon, Mars, or Earth
get.description: Return curated candidate base locations (Moon/Mars) or terrestrial analogs (Earth).

get.summary: Get fingerprint for a specific site or cell ID
get.description: Retrieve a single planetary site fingerprint by site_id or cell_id.

get.summary: Snap latitude/longitude coordinates to the nearest indexed cell
get.description: Snap a click at (lat, lon) on Moon, Mars, or Earth to its nearest indexed cell.

post.summary: Find top-K similar Earth analog locations for a Moon or Mars site
post.description:
Execute weighted multi-criteria similarity search across topography (robust z-score kernel),
geology (harmonized lithology similarity matrix), and mineralogy (masked cosine similarity).

get.summary: Get quantized similarity scores across all Earth cells for global heatmap rendering
get.description: Return quantized uint8 (0-100) similarity scores across all indexed Earth cells.

get.summary: Compare laser altimeter elevation profiles (ICESat-2 vs LOLA / MOLA)
get.description: Return side-by-side laser altimeter transects (ICESat-2 ATLAS vs LRO LOLA or MGS MOLA).
